		limit = { scope:te_cred_mono_company = { is_company_type = company_type:company_yoyodyne_propulsion } }
		te_cred_try_monopoly = { BT = building_aerospace_industry }
		te_cred_try_monopoly = { BT = building_antimatter_engine }
		te_cred_try_monopoly = { BT = building_yoyodyne_propulsion_hq }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:te_cred_mono_company = { is_company_type = company_type:company_zastava } }
		te_cred_try_monopoly = { BT = building_arms_industry }
		te_cred_try_monopoly = { BT = building_munition_plant }
		te_cred_try_monopoly = { BT = building_zastava_kragujevac_arsenal }
	}
}
